newsitem.title: UGANDA: SOCCER-KENYA TO HOST ZAIRE CLUB FOR AFRICAN CUP MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KENYA TO HOST ZAIRE CLUB FOR AFRICAN CUP MATCH.

text.p: The African Football Confederation (CAF) has arranged for Kenya to host a second-leg cup match between Uganda's Kampala City Council (KCC) and Zaire's AS Bantous on May 17 because of uncertain conditions in Zaire, KCC said on Sunday.
The first leg of the CAF Cup second-round match will be played in Kampala on May 3 and under normal conditions the second leg would be in AS Bantous' home town, Mbuji-Mayi, two weeks later.

But Mbuji-Mayi is now under control of the rebel Alliance which already controls half of Zaire and the CAF has accepted that KCC would have difficulty in travelling there, KCC officials said. The match will be played in Nairobi.
